description: Kühn, Paul and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed Kassel campaign supports evaluation of flow models in complex terrain. Seventeen devices comprise nine scanning lidars, six profiling instruments and two masts. A three-month intensive phase sits within the stated November 2016 to October 2017 campaign. Related blind-test material belongs to this same evaluation programme. The record documents the measurement and modelling application, without assuming unrestricted release of every instrument series or treating the campaign and blind test as independent field experiments. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
